common.title: Capability Jump
common.line: A discontinuous advance is released or demonstrated.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Attribution leak
notable.line: A joint investigative reporting consortium publishes forensic evidence credibly linking the autumn grid pre-positioning swarm to specific state-contracted compute clusters, forcing public attribution debate.

notable.title: Foundry supply squeeze
notable.line: A prolonged drought in Taiwan and power rationing notices force a major foundry to guide down output for two quarters, tightening global GPU and power-electronics supply and delaying European data-centre build-outs.

notable.title: Ot insurance pullback
notable.line: Major reinsurers temporarily exclude OT cyber-triggered business interruption for ports and grid operators after the autumn pre-positioning revelations, raising premiums and forcing temporary throughput limits.
